title: Envelope
description: Every message of the device channel. Unknown members are refused, so no content can travel by accident.

v.description: Major version of the channel; equals the version in the endpoint path (/ws/device/v1).

type.description: Message type; selects the schema of payload.

id.description: Unique message identifier (UUID v7); a receiver refuses an identifier it has already seen in the session.

ts.description: Time the sender created the message (RFC 3339, UTC).

payload.description: The message body, defined by the schema of its type.

sig.description: Signature of the Hub over the envelope without this member. Required on every message from the Hub.

key.description: SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, lowercase hex, prefixed with sha256:.

value.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes), base64url without padding.
